    crosses = []

    for r in range(1, h - 1):

            if (g[r][c] == 0 and g[r - 1][c] == 2 and g[r + 1][c] == 2
                    and g[r][c - 1] == 2 and g[r][c + 1] == 2):
                crosses.append((r, c))
                arms.update(((r - 1, c), (r + 1, c), (r, c - 1), (r, c + 1)))

    # Unclaimed 2 cells are point objects; connect collinear neighboring
    # objects, drawing 1s in the gap between their facing edges.
    nodes = [(r, c, 1) for r, c in crosses]
    nodes += [(r, c, 0) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
              if g[r][c] == 2 and (r, c) not in arms]

    def connect_line(items, fixed, horizontal):
        items.sort()
        for (p, e1), (q, e2) in zip(items, items[1:]):
            # e1/e2 are 1 for a cross (one arm toward the other node),
            # and 0 for a point object.
            start = p + e1 + 1
            stop = q - e2
            for x in range(start, stop):
                r, c = (fixed, x) if horizontal else (x, fixed)
                if g[r][c] == 0:
                    g[r][c] = 1

    for r in range(h):
        row_nodes = [(c, extent) for rr, c, extent in nodes if rr == r]
        connect_line(row_nodes, r, True)
    for c in range(w):
        col_nodes = [(r, extent) for r, cc, extent in nodes if cc == c]
        connect_line(col_nodes, c, False)
    return g
